create_Metadatum: create a _Metadatum namedtuple with a key and value for gRPC metadata
build_beta_metadatum: build a single beta metadatum by encoding a key and value to bytes
test_metadatum: test the _metadatum function to decode a beta key and value back to strings
refactor_beta: refactor the beta function to convert an iterable of metadata pairs to bytes
summarize_unbeta: summarize the unbeta function that converts beta metadata tuples back to string format
